text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Here we go! A birthday special short 
skit: 'The Manga Artist.'”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No good, I'm doomed! I won't make the 
deadline! Is my editor already on their 
way...?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Sensei! Leave this to your capable 
assistant! I'll buy you some time, so 
please work on your manuscript in the 
meantime!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that, but that editor is a 
real tough nut to crack, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Why the heck are ya workin' at my place?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Ahahaha! That's so true! I mean, 
you're right, but still!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's working on her. Ai-san, shall we 
move on to the next bit?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! There's more!? Huh, wasn't 
that already plenty!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet. On our birthday... when 
Kiseki-chan's manga made us laugh, it was 
way more than this!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, since Ai-san put it that way... I 
suppose we'll keep the "birthday 
celebration" going, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No way, are you serious...! Haaah... This 
is the absolute best.
